## Context File Template

`.qa/context.md` always has this shape, in this order. Do not add extra
top-level sections, and do not omit one — if there's genuinely nothing to
say (e.g. no external services), write "None found" rather than dropping
the heading.

```markdown
# Project Context — {project name}

<!-- Generated by qa-pipeline. Edited by hand? Add [manual] to any line
     you change and it will be preserved on the next update. -->

context_sha: {sha}
last_updated: {yyyy-mm-dd}

## 1. What this project does
{what it does, who uses it, main features}

## 2. Data schema
{main entities, key fields, relationships, and where this was read from}

## 3. Architecture
{entry points, main modules, external services, env vars}

## 4. Test coverage
{overall %, well/weakly/not covered modules, framework, known gaps}

## Changelog
- {yyyy-mm-dd} {sha} — {one line: what changed, or "first version"}
```

### Rules for filling it in

- **Mark inferred content.** Anything you worked out rather than read
  directly (e.g. "who uses this" when there's no explicit audience
  statement) gets `[inferred]` appended to that line. A later reader must be
  able to tell a fact from a guess at a glance.
- **Mark nothing else this way.** Don't add `[inferred]` to something you
  read directly from a README, docstring, or config file — that dilutes the
  signal.
- **`[manual]` is a human's marker, not yours.** You never write `[manual]`
  yourself. When a line already carries it, preserve that line's exact text
  on every future update, in every section, no matter what the rest of the
  section says. See `skills/build-context/SKILL.md`'s incremental
  update logic for exactly how this is enforced line-by-line.
- **Coverage numbers always come from `.qa/test-inventory.json`.** Never
  recompute them.
- **1,500 words, hard limit.** `/triage-tests` loads this whole file into
  its own context on every run — keep it dense, not exhaustive. Prefer a
  short accurate sentence over a long hedge.
- **If a whole section has nothing to report** (no external services, no
  env vars, no schema because the project has none), write that plainly —
  "None found." is a valid, complete answer for a subsection. Never leave a
  section blank or delete it.
